<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion (M+H) appears at m/z ≈ 121.05 with an M+1 intensity of ~8 %, indicating a molecule containing about 8 carbons. The neutral mass would be ~120.04 Da, which matches the exact mass of C₈H₈O (acetophenone, 120.0575 Da). The M+1 pattern is consistent with eight carbons. Therefore the most plausible structure is acetophenone, whose SMILES is “CC(=O)c1ccccc1”. This SMILES is valid.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
